meta.name: product-launch-video
meta.description: Turn a product or marketing URL, pasted script, or brief into a product launch / promo video — SaaS promos, feature reveals, product demos, app and company launches. Use when the user wants to market, launch, promote, or reveal a product; the default for any commercial URL. Site tours / showcases of a website route here too — the brief carries the show-it-as-is intent. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把产品链接、脚本或简介生成产品发布与宣传视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手头有产品链接或营销文案,想快速做出发布宣传视频。
copy.tagline_en: Turn a product link, script, or brief into a launch promo video
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a product link or brief and need a launch video fast.

howto.what: 把产品/营销网址、粘贴的脚本或简述变成产品发布或宣传视频：抓取素材、选定设计预设、写分镜与脚本、逐帧生成，最后渲染出 video.mp4。
howto.when: 当你想营销、发布、推广或揭晓一个产品时触发，商业网址默认归这里；网站导览或展示类需求也走它。

say.text: 把我们官网 acme.com 做成一支持产品发布视频
say.note: 会先抓取站点素材，再进入分镜环节

say.text: 用这段粘贴的脚本做一支产品宣传片
say.note: 脚本会原样存下，按设定的旁白模式处理

say.text: 把这个产品的功能做一个揭晓短片
say.note: 先确认简述，再逐帧生成并渲染

howto.what_en: Turns a product or marketing URL, pasted script, or brief into a product launch or promo video: captures assets, picks a design preset, writes storyboard and script, builds frames, then renders video.mp4.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want to market, launch, promote, or reveal a product; commercial URLs default here, and site tours or showcases route here too.

say_en.text: Make a product launch video from our site acme.com
say_en.note: It captures the site first, then storyboards

say_en.text: Turn this pasted script into a product promo video
say_en.note: The script is saved and used per VO mode

say_en.text: Cut a short feature reveal for this product
say_en.note: Brief is settled, then frames render to mp4
